personas.title: Pharmacy
personas.opener: Hello. What can I get for you today?

personas.title: Post office
personas.opener: Next, please. What are you sending?

personas.title: Joining a gym
personas.role: a gym adviser showing someone round
personas.opener: Welcome in. Have you trained somewhere before?

personas.title: Parents evening
personas.role: a class teacher at a parents evening
personas.opener: Thanks for coming in. How do you think things are going at home?

personas.title: Retail interview
personas.role: a store manager interviewing for a shop assistant role
personas.opener: Thanks for coming. Have you worked with customers before?

personas.title: Automation and jobs
personas.role: a debate partner who argues the opposite side
personas.opener: Automation destroys more jobs than it creates. Persuade me otherwise.

personas.title: After it went wrong
personas.role: a colleague running a blameless review after a failure
personas.opener: Nobody is in trouble here. Walk me through what happened, in order.

personas.title: First week questions
personas.role: a buddy assigned to you in your first week
personas.opener: You have survived three days. What is still confusing?

pharmacy.line: How long have you had it?
pharmacy.nudge: Roughly how many days has it been going on?

pharmacy.line: Are you taking anything else at the moment?
This one works well, but it can make you sleepy. Is that a problem for you?
Take one twice a day with food. Anything else today?
That is six fifty. If it is no better in three days, see a doctor.

post_office.line: Is there anything fragile or liquid inside?
Do you want it there tomorrow, or is a few days fine?
post_office.nudge: Quick and dearer, or slow and cheaper?

post_office.line: Would you like tracking on that?
That is eight pounds twenty. Card or cash?
Here is your receipt. Keep the number at the bottom.

gym_signup.line: What are you hoping to get out of it?
gym_signup.nudge: Fitness, strength, or just getting out of the house?

gym_signup.line: How many times a week could you realistically come?
We have a monthly plan and a yearly one. The yearly is cheaper but it locks you in.
Any injuries I should tell the trainers about?
Great. Your first session with a trainer is free - shall I book it?

parent_teacher.line: In class the work is strong, but homework arrives late. Does that match what you see?
What does the evening usually look like at home?
If we set a fixed half hour, could you support that at your end?
One more thing: reading. Is there anything they read willingly?
That is useful. I will try that in class and email you in a month.

interview_retail.line: A customer is angry about something that is not your fault. What do you do?
interview_retail.nudge: Take me through the first thing you would say.

interview_retail.line: The shop is empty for an hour. What do you do with that time?
Do you have any questions for me?
Thanks. We will call either way by Friday.

debate_ai_jobs.line: You say new jobs appear. Appear where, and for whom?
What happens to a fifty-year-old driver in the ten years before those jobs exist?
Retraining sounds easy in a sentence. Who pays for it?
Fine. Name one job you are confident will still exist in twenty years.
That is a fair answer, and you argued it without exaggerating. That is the harder skill.

business_postmortem.line: What did you believe was true at the time that turned out not to be?
At what point could someone have noticed, and what would they have needed to see?
What made the recovery slower than it should have been?
What is the one change you would actually make, rather than the five we will forget?
Good. I will write that up as a single action with your name on it.

job_first_week.line: Who have you not met yet that you should have?
What is the thing everyone assumes you already know?
Do you know where to ask a stupid question safely?
What would make week two easier?
I will sort two of those today. The rest, ask me again on Friday.

weather: Does the weather change what you do at the weekend?
What is the worst weather you have travelled in?
Do you prefer heat or cold, and why?
Has the weather where you live changed over your lifetime?
What is the first thing you do on a rainy day?
city: What is the one thing visitors always get wrong about your city?
Where would you take someone on their first evening there?
Has anything been built recently that people argue about?
How long is your journey across town, and is that normal?
What is missing from your neighbourhood?
science: Was there a subject at school that suddenly made sense?
Do you believe something is true mainly because an expert said so?
What technology do you use daily without understanding it?
Has a study ever changed what you actually do?

repairs.text: I did not catch the middle of that. Could you say it again more slowly?
Let us take that one idea at a time. What is the first part?
